summary: -i controls a loop inside the timed OpenMP parallel region. Its orphaned static worksharing loop distributes the full [0,dim) row range across the active team on each call; each row walks its complete CSR interval, accumulates matrix-value times indexed-vector products, and stores one output. The outlined outer worker retains the repetition back edge.

source_evidence.claim: The -i option assigns iterations; within the timed parallel region, every team thread enters the loop that calls spmvCpu once per iteration.
The orphaned OpenMP static worksharing loop covers all rows [0,dim); each row traverses rowDelimiters[i] to rowDelimiters[i+1], accumulates val[j]*vec[cols[j]], and stores out[i].

compiled_evidence.claim: The timed region launches the outlined OpenMP worker. The worker calls spmvCpu, increments its counter, compares it with the configured iteration count, and branches back to repeat.

primary_quality_check.method: Read all four proposals and checked source/binary binding of every citation. Directly checked r4 persistent OpenMP team, per-iteration orphaned worksharing with barrier, complete rows/nonzeros, emitted outer loop and worker backedges. Checked r5 adjacent nonzero-balanced lower_bound row partitions, full CSR traversal, host repetition backedge and compiled row/nonzero loops/stores. No missing work identified.
primary_quality_check.timestamp_provenance: Conservative enclosing interval, not an exact duration: 22:07:09Z is the known launch lower bound and 22:11:13Z is an actual clock observation bounding completion. The earlier 22:08:42Z and 22:09:05Z values were actual clock observations, but neither marked the review-start or completion event.
